# DripLove

> DripLove is a free dating app for iPhone, Android and the web for meeting real singles near you and around the world. It is built and operated by The ScREAte Ltd.

DripLove helps adults (18+) meet people locally and internationally, chat in real time and build genuine connections. Members can verify their profile with a selfie, photos are checked automatically and by a human team, and every profile and conversation has report and block tools.

## Key facts

- Platforms: iPhone (App Store), Android (Google Play) and web (https://www.driplove.love)
- Price: free to join and use; optional Premium subscription
- Premium includes: unlimited daily swipes, see everyone who liked you, unlimited undo of dislikes, fewer ads, up to 4 additional countries to explore, priority support
- Free members: 15–20 swipes a day, 2 undos a day, matching within their own country
- Safety: selfie verification, photo checks, reporting and blocking, 18+ only, zero tolerance for child sexual abuse and exploitation
- Features: discovery and matching, real-time chat, icebreaker games (Red Flag Green Flag, Shoot Your Shot, Test Your Toast)
- Languages: English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Arabic, Chinese, Swahili
- Company: The ScREAte Ltd — contact info@driplove.love
